Definition: from G1485; to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle) customary:--custom.
BiblicalUsage: The word ethízō covers to accustom. It occurs just once, in Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ethízō as it stands — to accustom — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
